scientific_question: Holding a,c,d and r fixed, does a frozen neural student's raw-bit answer follow a changed second input word b, and does r=1 stay invariant?
one_changed_input: Only six raw bits of the second payload word b; fixed a, c, d and r within each contrast; no training modifications.
legal_profile: SLE-AE1-n5-v1: Q=01+010+r(3 information bits+0)+4*(5 information bits+0)+END111100, r in {1,2}; answer first r complete six-bit words followed by external S STOP. Ordinary IDs 0..29; 30/31 reserved.

baseline_checkpoint_scope.optimizer: torch Adam lr 0.003, mini-batch 64, gradient clip 1

dataset.split: (a+b)%6 -> val if 0, test if 1, otherwise train; only anchors are original 6 test pairs
dataset.anchors: one test pair (a,b0) per a=0..5, with (a+b0)%6=1
dataset.intervention: for each anchor, keep a and c0=15+(7a+3b0)%15, d0=15+(5a+11b0)%15, choose b=0..5; run separately r=1 and r=2
dataset.total: 4 frozen models * 6 anchors * 6 b * 2 r = 288 generated responses; 4*6*5*2=240 changed-b contrasts

raw_bits_examples.note: Example is illustrative; runner generates and checks literal raw bits from formula, not this string.

pre_run_gates: Check exact Git blob SHA-1 of all 5 inputs, and 4 torch-order tensor content SHA-256 against recorded final_weights_sha256
Independent JS dense tanh forward must reproduce every one of the 864 archived r1/r2 outputs exactly; otherwise abort before intervention
Q length=39, correct headers, 6-bit words 0..29, END=111100; each b-only comparison differs in exactly b position
All 4 model×6-anchor×6-b×2-r evaluated; no seed/model cherry picking
metrics: r1 output invariance and exactness under b-only perturbation
r2 exact/first_word/second_word/STOP correctness, stratified by original b0 vs changed b and by inherited train/val/test split of (a,b)
r2 second-word response follows new b versus equals baseline b0, conditional on first-word and output length
Full raw Q/target/generated outputs and mismatches, including no-STOP/cap cases
acceptance: Report failures, all models and actual operations, no population/general-copy claim; no new optimizer updates, no oracle, no change to existing checkpoint. Do not infer generalization from values of b that were trained with other suffixes.
